he: שִׁ֗יר הַֽמַּ֫עֲל֥וֹת זְכוֹר־יְהֹוָ֥ה לְדָוִ֑ד אֵ֝֗ת כׇּל־עֻנּוֹתֽוֹ׃
en: A song of the ascents: Remember, Havayah, to Dawid — all his afflictions.

he: אֲשֶׁ֣ר נִ֭שְׁבַּע לַֽיהֹוָ֑ה נָ֝דַ֗ר לַאֲבִ֥יר יַעֲקֹֽב׃
en: Who swore to Havayah; vowed to Avir Yaakov.

he: אִם־אָ֭בֹא בְּאֹ֣הֶל בֵּיתִ֑י אִם־אֶ֝עֱלֶ֗ה עַל־עֶ֥רֶשׂ יְצוּעָֽי׃
en: If I enter the tent of my house; if I go up upon the couch of my bed;
If I give sleep to my eyes; slumber to my eyelids;

he: עַד־אֶמְצָ֣א מָ֭קוֹם לַיהֹוָ֑ה מִ֝שְׁכָּנ֗וֹת לַאֲבִ֥יר יַעֲקֹֽב׃
en: Until I find a place for Havayah; dwellings for Avir Yaakov.
Behold, we heard it in Ephratah; we found it in the fields of the forest.
We shall come to His dwellings; we shall bow to the footstool of His feet.

he: קוּמָ֣ה יְ֭הֹוָה לִמְנוּחָתֶ֑ךָ אַ֝תָּ֗ה וַאֲר֥וֹן עֻזֶּֽךָ׃
en: Rise, Havayah, to Your resting place; You and the ark of Your strength.
Your kohanim shall don righteousness; and Your pious shall sing.

he: בַּ֭עֲבוּר דָּוִ֣ד עַבְדֶּ֑ךָ אַל־תָּ֝שֵׁ֗ב פְּנֵ֣י מְשִׁיחֶֽךָ׃
en: For the sake of Dawid Your servant, do not turn away the face of Your anointed.

he: נִשְׁבַּֽע־יְהֹוָ֨ה ׀ לְדָוִ֡ד אֱמֶת֮ לֹא־יָשׁ֢וּב מִ֫מֶּ֥נָּה מִפְּרִ֥י בִטְנְךָ֑ אָ֝שִׁ֗ית לְכִסֵּא־לָֽךְ׃
en: Havayah swore to Dawid in truth; He shall not turn from it: From the fruit of your belly I shall set for a throne to you.

he: אִֽם־יִשְׁמְר֬וּ בָנֶ֨יךָ ׀ בְּרִיתִי֮ וְעֵדֹתִ֥י ז֗וֹ אֲלַ֫מְּדֵ֥ם גַּם־בְּנֵיהֶ֥ם עֲדֵי־עַ֑ד יֵ֝שְׁב֗וּ לְכִסֵּא־לָֽךְ׃
en: If your sons keep My covenant, and this My testimony that I shall teach them, their sons too, forever, shall sit for a throne to you.

he: כִּי־בָחַ֣ר יְהֹוָ֣ה בְּצִיּ֑וֹן אִ֝וָּ֗הּ לְמוֹשָׁ֥ב לֽוֹ׃
en: For Havayah chose Tzion; He desired it for a dwelling for Him.
This is My rest forever; here I shall sit, for I desired it.

he: צֵ֭ידָהּ בָּרֵ֣ךְ אֲבָרֵ֑ךְ אֶ֝בְיוֹנֶ֗יהָ אַשְׂבִּ֥יעַֽ לָֽחֶם׃
en: Her provision I shall bless, bless; her poor I shall satisfy with bread.

he: וְֽ֭כֹהֲנֶיהָ אַלְבִּ֣ישׁ יֶ֑שַׁע וַ֝חֲסִידֶ֗יהָ רַנֵּ֥ן יְרַנֵּֽנוּ׃
en: And her kohanim I shall clothe with salvation; and her pious shall sing, sing.

he: שָׁ֤ם אַצְמִ֣יחַ קֶ֣רֶן לְדָוִ֑ד עָרַ֥כְתִּי נֵ֝֗ר לִמְשִׁיחִֽי׃
en: There I shall make sprout a horn to Dawid; I have arranged a lamp for My anointed.

he: א֭וֹיְבָיו אַלְבִּ֣ישׁ בֹּ֑שֶׁת וְ֝עָלָ֗יו יָצִ֥יץ נִזְרֽוֹ׃ {פ}
en: His enemies I shall clothe with shame; and upon him his crown shall blossom.
